ground_truth_basis: Maintainer-reviewed fixture source; these are expected answers, not observed Agent results.

questions.question: 点击收藏按钮后，数据是怎么保存的？
expected_facts: The localized favorite.button button invokes DemoViewController favoriteTapped:.
favoriteTapped: calls FavoriteStore saveFavorite: with the title Offline reverse engineering.
FavoriteStore persists the collection in NSUserDefaults under aire.favorites.v1.
must_not_claim: A direct dispatch edge solely because two methods share a selector
SQLite or a custom file store

questions.question: 收藏内容启动时从哪里恢复？如果没有收藏会怎么样？
expected_facts: DemoViewController viewDidLoad calls loadFavorites when initializing its status label.
FavoriteStore loadFavorites uses NSUserDefaults arrayForKey: with aire.favorites.v1.
Missing stored data produces an empty array.
must_not_claim: A network request is needed to restore favorites

questions.question: 重复收藏和空标题分别怎么处理？
expected_facts: An empty title returns before modifying the collection.
containsObject: checks for an existing title.
Only absent titles are appended and written back to defaults.

questions.question: 获取验证码按钮会向哪里发送什么请求？
expected_facts: requestCodeTapped: calls LoginService requestCode:.
The URL is https://api.aire-demo.invalid/v1/auth/code and HTTP method is POST.
The Content-Type header is application/json.
The JSON body contains phone and purpose, with purpose set to login.
NSURLSession creates a data task and resume starts it.
must_not_claim: The reserved .invalid endpoint is a working service
A request was executed during static analysis

questions.question: 所有 saveFavorite: 方法都会持久化收藏吗？预览按钮有什么区别？
expected_facts: FavoriteStore and PreviewStore both declare saveFavorite:.
PreviewStore only copies the title into its _lastPreview instance variable and logs it.
previewTapped: uses the PreviewStore receiver.
The shared selector alone does not establish which receiver a dynamic call targets.
must_not_claim: Every saveFavorite: call is definitely a FavoriteStore call

questions.question: 验证码请求失败时会重试或向用户展示错误吗？
expected_facts: The completion block logs error.localizedDescription and returns on a transport error.
No retry or UI error presentation is implemented in this fixture.
The code does not check HTTP status or parse a success response payload.
must_not_claim: Any response proves login or verification succeeded
